# Ophlow

> Ophlow builds simple operations software for teams who work on their feet, not at a desk. Our first product runs the day at an assisted living community: housekeeping, dining, maintenance, and activities sharing one live system across a manager website and a staff phone app.

## What we do

Ophlow replaces paper, whiteboards, and group texts with timestamped digital workflows for frontline teams. Every check-in, clean, order, and repair gets a timestamp instead of a scribble. Staff see only the screens for their job on the phone they already carry. Managers see where the time goes: checkout-to-room-ready, minutes per clean against target, meal order to tray delivered, repair request to fixed.

## Product one: Ophlow for Senior Living

A manager website and a staff phone app sharing one live system, built side by side with an assisted living operations team. Currently in live pilot.

- Private by design: the system works with room numbers only. Resident names and health information never go into the system, and each person sees only the screens for their job.
- Housekeeping: room cleans with checklists, timers, inspection pass/send-back flow, and a release button for stuck cleans.
- Dining, maintenance, activities, and role-based access for managers, directors, and staff.

## How we work

1. We shadow the floor: spend time with the people doing the work and map every clipboard, whiteboard, and group text.
2. We build the smallest useful thing: working software in weeks, faster than the paper it replaces.
3. We ship with the team: weekly releases, and the people using the tool decide what gets built next.
4. We measure the minutes: every step is timed, so improvements are proven with data.

## Markets

- Senior living (live pilot): assisted living operations — rooms, housekeeping, dining, maintenance, activities.
- Exploring: hospitality, property management, clinics and outpatient care, facilities and light industry.
